story: The Keeper's reflection on Genesis 8:1-9:17 (KJV, public domain), said to the camera in 3 segments (the bottom half of flood-ends-long-reflection-1)

narration.text: God did not hang that rainbow because Noah was perfect, and the story says so plainly.
He failed again, the way people do, and God still hung up His own bow.
So if you are waiting on God tonight, you are not forgotten. You are carried.
